title: trond shadow-fork mutate output
description: Returned by `trond shadow-fork mutate ... -o json`. Counters mirror dbfork.Result and java DbFork's stdout summary lines.

data_dir.description: Path to the java-tron data directory the mutation was applied to (parent of database/).

config.description: Path to the fork.conf that was applied.

format.description: Format flag value as passed (auto / hocon / yaml). Reports the operator's input, NOT the resolved format — `auto` here means extension-detection was used; the resolved value is not surfaced through the CLI today.

retain_witnesses.description: Whether the existing witness store was preserved (true) or wiped-then-rewritten (false). Mirrors the --retain-witnesses flag.

witnesses_written.description: Count of Witness protos written to witnessStore. Equals len(cfg.Witnesses) on the happy path.

active_witnesses.description: Count of addresses in the new witnessScheduleStore active-witness slate. Capped at MaxActiveWitnessNum (27).

accounts_modified.description: Count of fork.conf account specs processed. Matches java DbFork's `{n} accounts have been modified` stdout.

trc20_slots_updated.description: Count of storage-row slots written. Specs targeting a missing TRC20 contract are skipped silently and do NOT increment.

properties_updated.description: DynamicProperties keys modified (0..3: latestBlockHeaderTimestamp, maintenanceTimeInterval, nextMaintenanceTime).

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of Apply, in milliseconds.
